items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He was a popular band... I used to get them mixed up when I was a kid. I thought the drummer was the leader! I thought he was George Tines(?). But George Tines(?) was the piano player.

ctx.x: What other bands did you hear, then, before you came to New York? What did you hear in Boston?

Well, they had Boston bands, you know. They had bands up there. But I can't remember the name. There was a band that did the most work, that was the most popular amongst the Colored people, was George Tines(?). He was a popular band. But there were a lot of bands...
